clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、同性婚が現行の法制度で認められていないことに対する問題意識が中心であり、法的な平等が未だに確立されていない現状や、社会的不平等の存在を指摘しています。また、同性婚に関する具体的な施策や支援が不足していること、法整備の必要性、そして人権問題としての重要性が強調されています。

clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、現行の戸籍制度が時代遅れであり、法的な取り扱いや表現が不明確であること、また多様な家族観や個人の価値観が十分に反映されていない点に焦点を当てています。特に、出生時のDNA鑑定の制度化や同性婚の法制化を通じて、現代の社会における多様性を尊重し、戸籍制度の改善が求められています。

clusters.label: 選択的夫婦別姓制度の未整備による個人の自由とアイデンティティの制約

clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、同性カップルが法的に認められていないことによる権利の不平等や社会的差別についての懸念が中心です。特に、同性婚が法制化されていないことが、同性カップルの法的保護や権利の保障を妨げており、これが生活の安定性や社会的な平等に対する障壁となっている点が強調されています。

clusters.label: 結婚に伴う姓変更と旧姓使用に関する社会的課題
clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、結婚に伴う姓の変更や旧姓の使用に関する制度的な問題点や社会的な理解不足に焦点を当てています。特に、旧姓使用の権利が不十分であることや、婚姻後の姓変更が個人のアイデンティティやキャリア形成に与える不利益、さらには現行の夫婦同氏制度が個人の尊厳を侵害する可能性についての懸念が表れています。これらの意見は、より柔軟で個人の意思を尊重した姓のあり方を求める声としてまとめられます。

clusters.label: 夫婦同姓制度とジェンダー平等の課題

clusters.label: 結婚制度における男女平等と多様性の保障
clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、結婚制度における男女間の不平等や性的少数者の権利の不足に対する認識を示しています。現行の制度が人権や自由を十分に尊重していないこと、また、婚姻における平等が保障されていない現状に対する問題提起が中心です。特に、結婚の自由をすべての人に提供する必要性や、宗教的背景を持つ人々のニーズに応えることの重要性が強調されています。

clusters.label: 選択的夫婦別姓制度の未導入による家族の多様性の制約
clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、現行の夫婦同姓制度が選択的夫婦別姓を認めていないことにより、社会的多様性や個人の選択が尊重されていないという問題意識が中心です。多様な家族観やライフスタイルを持つ夫婦が自由に姓を選べないことが、社会全体の多様性の欠如や不平等感を助長しているという指摘が多く見られます。

clusters.label: 結婚における多様な心理的・社会的障壁の分析
clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、結婚に関する様々な心理的、社会的、経済的な障壁についての認識や問題提起が中心です。特に、結婚に対する無意識の偏見や社会的なバイアス、制度的な未整備が個人の幸福や安定に影響を与えていることが強調されています。また、葬送文化における選択肢の限界も関連しており、結婚と葬送の両面での社会的な対応が求められています。

clusters.label: 職場と社会におけるジェンダー平等の不十分な実現と政策の欠如
clusters.takeaway: この意見グループは、職場や社会全体におけるジェンダー平等が未だに実現されていないことに対する懸念を示しています。具体的には、ジェンダーギャップの解消に向けた政策が不十分であり、教育や育児におけるジェンダー平等の視点が欠けていることが指摘されています。また、トランスジェンダーの権利や多様性の尊重が政策に反映されていないことも問題視されています。

1_1.label: Necessity of institutional reform respecting diverse family forms and individual rights
1_1.takeaway: Concerns are growing that the current marriage system and family legislation do not sufficiently respect diverse family forms and individual choices. In particular, the fact that the selective dual surname system and the legalization of same-sex marriage remain undeveloped is causing restrictions on individual freedom and identity, and is affecting the realization of gender equality. It has also been pointed out that economic and social barriers in matchmaking activities and unconscious biases against marriage are contributing to the trend of remaining unmarried. To address these issues, reviews of legal systems and the formulation of concrete policies are required.

2_10.label: Need for Legal Frameworks and Social Equality Regarding Same-Sex Marriage
2_10.takeaway: This opinion group primarily expresses a sense of problem regarding the fact that same-sex marriage is not recognized under the current legal system, pointing out the current situation where legal equality has yet to be established and the existence of social inequality. Furthermore, the lack of concrete measures and support regarding same-sex marriage, the necessity of legal frameworks, and its importance as a human rights issue are emphasized.

2_101.label: Review of the Koseki System in Modern Society and Respect for Diversity
2_101.takeaway: This opinion group focuses on the fact that the current Koseki (family register) system is outdated, its legal handling and expressions are unclear, and diverse views on family and individual values are not sufficiently reflected. In particular, improvements to the Koseki system are sought through the institutionalization of DNA testing at birth and the legalization of same-sex marriage to respect diversity in modern society.

2_129.label: Diversity of Family Systems and the Necessity of Reviewing Current Laws
2_129.takeaway: This opinion group primarily centers on concerns that the current family law system does not sufficiently respond to diverse family forms and values. In particular, it points out the lack of legal frameworks regarding the parental authority system, the handling of infidelity, and the acceptance of diverse families including same-sex marriage, calling for institutional reviews to respect the diversity of families in modern society.

2_139.label: Constraints on individual freedom and identity due to the absence of a selective separate surname system
2_139.takeaway: This opinion group focuses on the point that individual freedom of choice and identity are constrained because a selective separate surname system has not been established. Many opinions express that under the current system, where couples are forced to share the same surname, individual rights and diverse lifestyles are not respected, specifically pointing out inconveniences in maintaining identity and engaging in social activities.

2_210.label: Issues Regarding Legal Rights and Guarantee of Equality for Same-Sex Couples
2_210.takeaway: This opinion group centers on concerns about inequality of rights and social discrimination resulting from the fact that same-sex couples are not legally recognized. In particular, it is emphasized that the lack of legalization of same-sex marriage hinders legal protection and the guarantee of rights for same-sex couples, acting as a barrier to stability of living and social equality.

2_236.label: Social issues regarding name changes upon marriage and the use of maiden names
2_236.takeaway: This opinion group focuses on institutional problems and a lack of social understanding regarding name changes upon marriage and the use of maiden names. In particular, concerns are expressed about the insufficiency of the right to use a maiden name, the disadvantages that changing one's name after marriage imposes on personal identity and career development, and the possibility that the current compulsory couple's same-surname system violates individual dignity. These opinions can be summarized as calls for a way of handling surnames that is more flexible and respects individual will.

2_238.label: Lack of Legal Protection and Social Understanding for Diverse Partnerships
2_238.takeaway: This opinion group focuses on the insufficiency of legal frameworks and social recognition regarding diverse partnerships. In particular, concerns are expressed that the lack of a same-sex marriage system and the slow progress in legislating partnership systems are causing a failure to ensure equal rights and a lack of communication. It is also pointed out that there is a deficiency in understanding and support for diverse partnerships across society as a whole.

2_250.label: Economic and Social Barriers in Marriage Hunting and Lack of Opportunities to Meet
2_250.takeaway: This opinion group reflects a sense of problem that economic burdens in marriage hunting (konkatsu), insufficient marriage support systems, and a lack of opportunities to meet are promoting trends toward remaining unmarried or marrying later in life. In particular, it is emphasized that mismatches in romantic relationships between men and women and economic anxiety regarding marriage act as barriers for those who wish to marry. Additionally, the weakening function of traditional matchmaking and the low quality of current marriage hunting services are pointed out, showing that these factors combine to create an environment where people wishing to marry cannot find partners with peace of mind.

2_326.label: The Same-Surname System for Married Couples and Challenges of Gender Equality
2_326.takeaway: This opinion group points out that the current system, which legally mandates that married couples use the same surname, is a serious problem for gender equality. In particular, concerns are expressed that the lack of a selective separate surname system and the lack of public understanding regarding institutional changes to name changes are promoting gender inequality.

2_34.label: Discussions on the necessity of the selective dual surname system and its social impact
2_34.takeaway: This opinion group centers on discussions regarding the insufficient response to diverse family forms due to the non-introduction of the selective dual surname system, as well as social and legal concerns accompanying the introduction of the system. In particular, the impact of the absence of the system on child welfare and the nature of the family, as well as concerns regarding the relationship with the Koseki (family register) system, are emphasized. Furthermore, the lack of clarity in policy direction and the slow progress of discussions are pointed out, and the need for specific institutional development is called for.

2_351.label: Guarantee of Gender Equality and Diversity in the Marriage System
2_351.takeaway: This opinion group expresses awareness of inequality between men and women and the lack of rights for sexual minorities within the marriage system. The focus is on raising problems regarding the current system not sufficiently respecting human rights and freedoms, and the reality where equality in marriage is not guaranteed. In particular, the necessity of providing freedom of marriage to all people and the importance of meeting the needs of people with religious backgrounds are emphasized.

2_388.label: Constraints on family diversity due to the non-introduction of the selective dual surname system
2_388.takeaway: This opinion group centers on the awareness that social diversity and individual choice are not being respected because the current same-surname system for married couples does not allow for selective separate surnames. Many point out that the inability of couples with diverse views on family and lifestyles to freely choose their surnames fosters a lack of diversity and a sense of inequality across society as a whole.

2_40.label: Analysis of Diverse Psychological and Social Barriers to Marriage
2_40.takeaway: This opinion group focuses on perceptions and problem-posing regarding various psychological, social, and economic barriers to marriage. In particular, it is emphasized that unconscious biases and social prejudices against marriage, as well as institutional inadequacies, affect individual happiness and stability. The limited options in funeral culture are also related, and social responses are sought for both marriage and funerals.

2_79.label: Insufficient realization of gender equality in the workplace and society and lack of policy
2_79.takeaway: This opinion group expresses concern that gender equality in the workplace and society as a whole has yet to be realized. Specifically, it points out that policies aimed at closing the gender gap are insufficient and that a perspective of gender equality is missing in education and childcare. The fact that transgender rights and respect for diversity are not reflected in policy is also viewed as a problem.

config.intro: 「チームみらい 2025 参院選「しゃべれるマニフェスト」に届いた政策提案」のうち、まとまり「多様な家族形態と個人の権利を尊重する制度改革の必要性」の意見 659 件。2025 年参院選で、チームみらいの「しゃべれるマニフェスト」（AI インタビュアーが市民と対話してマニフェストへの変更提案を GitHub の PR として出す仕組み）に届いた 9,688 件の PR から、課題を抽出し、広聴AI で意見 21,348 件に分けて分析した結果。出典：チームみらい・しゃべれるマニフェスト参加者 / データセット nishiohirokazu/team-mirai-2025-embeddings（CC BY 4.0）
